name: radixark/miles
title: RadixArk releases DaisyRose-27B, a Qwen3.8-27B tuned with RL on 1,200 agent tasks, lifting Terminal-Bench 4.1 from 5.6% to 12.0%
summary: Open BF16, FP8 and NVFP4 weights (55.6, 30.9 and 21.9 GB) from the SGLang team, trained in 18 days on 144 H200s with Miles; smaller gains on Terminal-Bench 2.1, DeepSWE and GPQA Diamond. Community GGUF quants (Q4_K_M 17.3 GB) fit a 24 GB card for the weights alone.

appearances.title: Miles v0.2 adds production RL on more hardware
appearances.summary: Miles v0.2 brings production reinforcement learning to NVIDIA and AMD GPUs, with early Google TPU support and AWS Trainium planned next. It trains reliably on mixed GPUs and precisions with fully async rollouts, makes multimodal RL lighter across image, video, and audio, runs diffusion training async, and lets Multi-LoRA jobs share one base model.
